typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Entity Name} as string,
		CCY as string,
		{CCY Amount} as string,
		{USD Equiv Amount} as string,
		{Source Type} as string,
		{Value Date} as string,
		{Age Business days} as string,
		{Age Calender days} as string,
		{Trade ID} as string,
		{Transfer ID} as string,
		{Front Office ID} as string,
		Book as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Product Sub Type} as string,
		{Transfer Type} as string,
		{Transfer Status} as string,
		{Desk Name} as string,
		{Charge Off Date} as string,
		BDt as string,
		Comments as string,
		{Settlement Method} as string,
		{Entity Class} as string,
		{Reg W} as string,
		{Counterparty Name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		BusinessType = 'NONBANK') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		ChargeOffDate as string,
		SettlementMethod as string,
		CounterpartyName as string,
		Comments as string,
		TradeID as string,
		FrontOfficeID as string,
		ProductSubType as string,
		Amount as string,
		SourceType as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BusinessType as string,
		TransferType as string,
		DeskName as string,
		Age_CalenderDays as string,
		BDt as string,
		TransferStatus as string,
		ValueDate as string,
		Desk as string,
		Age as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ChargeOffDate = {Charge Off Date},
		SettlementMethod = {Settlement Method},
		CounterpartyName = {Counterparty Name},
		Comments,
		TradeID = {Trade ID},
		FrontOfficeID = {Front Office ID},
		ProductSubType = {Product Sub Type},
		Amount = {USD Equiv Amount},
		SourceType = {Source Type},
		ProductType = {Product Type},
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		BusinessType,
		TransferType = {Transfer Type},
		DeskName = {Desk Name},
		Age_CalenderDays = {Age Calender days},
		BDt,
		TransferStatus = {Transfer Status},
		ValueDate = {Value Date},
		Desk = Book,
		Age = {Age Business days}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
